parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to 5 minutes ago.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now. Max duration is 1 hour.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description:
Optional. Restrict to metrics from services tagged with this
deployment environment (e.g. `production`, `staging`). Services
without the tag return no metrics under any env filter.
